Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.

-- Let me verify the final query one more time and check for any edge cases
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, pizza_id) as row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
recipe_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        r.pizza_id,
        TRIM(SPLIT_PART(r.toppings, ',', s.n)) as topping_id
    FROM pizza_recipes r
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, 12)) AS s(n)
    WHERE TRIM(SPLIT_PART(r.toppings, ',', s.n)) != ''
),
standard AS (
    SELECT 
        b.row_id,
        b.order_id,
        b.customer_id,
        b.pizza_id,
        b.order_time,
        rt.topping_id
    FROM base b
    JOIN recipe_toppings rt ON b.pizza_id = rt.pizza_id
    WHERE rt.topping_id NOT IN (
        SELECT TRIM(SPLIT_PART(b.exclusions, ',', s.n))
        FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, 10)) AS s(n)
        WHERE b.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND b.exclusions != ''
        AND TRIM(SPLIT_PART(b.exclusions, ',', s.n)) != ''
    )
),
extras AS (
    SELECT 
        b.row_id,
        b.order_id,
        b.customer_id,
        b.pizza_id,
        b.order_time,
        TRIM(SPLIT_PART(b.extras, ',', s.n)) as topping_id
    FROM base b
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, 10)) AS s(n)
    WHERE b.extras IS NOT NULL AND b.extras != ''
    AND TRIM(SPLIT_PART(b.extras, ',', s.n)) != ''
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_id FROM standard
    UNION ALL
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_id FROM extras
),
topping_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_id,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM all_toppings
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_id
),
formatted AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.row_id,
        tc.order_id,
        tc.customer_id,
        tc.pizza_id,
        tc.order_time,
        pt.topping_name,
        tc.cnt,
        CASE WHEN tc.cnt > 1 THEN '2x ' || pt.topping_name ELSE pt.topping_name END as display_name
    FROM topping_counts tc
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON tc.topping_id = pt.topping_id::INTEGER
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        f.row_id,
        f.order_id,
        f.customer_id,
        f.pizza_id,
        f.order_time,
        pn.pizza_name,
        STRING_AGG(
            CASE WHEN f.cnt > 1 THEN '2x ' || f.topping_name ELSE f.topping_name END,
            ', '
            ORDER BY 
                CASE WHEN f.cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                f.topping_name
        ) as ingredients
    FROM formatted f
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON f.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    GROUP BY f.row_id, f.order_id, f.customer_id, f.pizza_id, f.order_time, pn.pizza_name
)
SELECT 
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients as final_ingredients
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY row_id
